scope: DMR1 variant 1, session kind dmr1_merge_build only
hardware: one NVIDIA L40S, secure cloud, at most $1.11/h, 150 GB container disk, no network volume

terms.basis: RI-LM1's measured statistics pass (117 s for 14 blocks) and assignments (1,420 s for 8 on the pod's CPU), scaled to 29 blocks and 20 pairs; the bound doubles every compute step and takes the init's verify download at the 2.6 MB/s floor x 1.25

money_rules.own_envelope: its own grant; the envelope counts only this kind's runs; SOB1's closed grants' remainders are void and fund nothing here
money_rules.balance: the provider balance must cover the hard cap plus the reserve at issue and at launch; a top-up is not a grant
money_rules.teardown_reserve: $1.00 held outside the ceiling, never issued

decision: Maintainer, 2026-11-27 (review of 6e3ee3a7): "本消息授权以下两个 kind：dmr1_merge_build — V1 初始化构建、登记诊断及持久化，累计硬上限 $5.43，关闭预留 $1.00；dmr1_merge_train — 两个种子的恢复训练、思考与非思考正式评测及收尾，累计硬上限 $64.46，关闭预留 $1.00；合计 V1 全链路 $69.89，关闭预留 $2.00。总授权上限为 $71.89，项目总上限保持 $1,161.06。按已审核的 proposal 签发对应 grant。以上额度覆盖各 kind 的全部 attempts，重试或更换 Pod 不会重置额度；关闭预留仅用于收尾。优先使用 L40S，遵循登记的价格与资源上限。不扩开发机磁盘，不购买 HF PRO 或其他额外存储。本次不授权 V2、V3，也不授权它们的 GPU 引擎验证。"
authorizes: DMR1-M's phase only (scope): its session kinds ['dmr1_merge_build'], inside ceiling_usd cumulatively, per_session_hard_cap_usd per session and the project cap; one-use artifacts from `issue`; no other study and no follow-up
